name: Kanawanai ne, Onii-chan!!
original_name: 敵わないねっ、お兄ちゃん！！
source:
A story about a masochistic older brother who gets bullied by his cute younger brother and always ends up suffering. His younger brother
seems like a sharp-tongued boy, but in reality...
